topic: Petra Treasury carved into the cliff
hook: Your first view of Petra is a carved cliff.
title: The Jordan Building Carved Into a Cliff
description:
Petra's famous Treasury was carved straight into rose-red sandstone cliff by the Nabataeans. Much of the whole city was cut from rock, which is why it is nicknamed the Rose City. Part of the series Places That Shouldn't Exist.

#Shorts #Petra #Jordan
